description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) representing the different types of command processing results within the Fineract project. It includes various result types such as INVALID, PROCESSED, AWAITING_APPROVAL, REJECTED, UNDER_PROCESSING, and ERROR, each associated with an integer value and a language key for localization. The enum provides methods to retrieve an enum instance from an integer, and to check specific statuses like processed, awaiting approval, or rejected.

classes.name: CommandProcessingResultType
classes.description: An enum representing different command processing result types, with associated integer codes and localization keys, and utility methods.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer value to a CommandProcessingResultType enum value, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a processed command.

methods.name: isAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a command awaiting approval.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a rejected command.
